name: SSH to Grok Bot via Tailscale
tagline: Puts the bot's own computer on your tailnet so you can shell straight in
description: Walks the bot through installing Tailscale on its machine the first time you run it, then gives you a way to open a shell over your tailnet from either a local client or the web console. Once it is in place you can treat the bot's computer like any other box on your network instead of working only through chat.
author: app_sail
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
